name: Animoon
rootCause: The work of Animoon with 9999 NFTs is taken from Pokémon. They claim to have signed a non-disclosure agreement (NDA) with Pokémon partner TopDeck. But with no evidence of an actual P2E game being developed, the Animoon team disappeared, deleting their Twitter account and website.
